positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
-Android multimedia I/O porting, integration and troubleshooting for different devices using StageFright framework, OpenMAXAL framework and OpenSLES framework.
-Troubleshooting, testing and bug fixing of multimedia protocols adapters for a multimedia player (HTTP live streaming, DASH, Smooth Streaming).
-Implementation of multimedia engine components.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
-Integration and support of media I/O components for symbian products
-Unit test design, development and support (symbian, win32, android)
-Experience developing symbian applications

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
·Quality Assurance Engineer 
Analyze and develop a test plan for any given multimedia product of the NSeries devices. Test plan will contain all supported features like DRM verification for WMA files, license checking, UI functionality, codec testing, bit rate, sample rate, audio format and file containers.
Compiling and debugging the modules (audio controller, license server, content access framework). 
Bug fixing, the founded solution needs no be placed under the revision of a Senior Engineer or developer (in case of not founding the solution for a given bug I must provide sufficient evidence to prove were the bug/crash is located).
Porting the product to different devices, and verify the functionality.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
·Maintenance, support & documentation of every Automatic Test Equipment 
In this area my responsibilities were to document, give maintenance and support to every ATE lab equipment. The documentation should include test procedures, hardware schematics for every test module, calibration procedure, bill of materials, data sheets, replacements and vendors. 


·Software design and signal conditioning (Test Engineer)
In order to test a certain product in the production line, there must be an Automatic Tester for high manufacturing volume. The Automatic testers are design and built in the CRYDOM Test Engineering Lab. The ATE software is developed in C for virtual instrumentation. The software UI plots the waveforms and displays the measurements of  all the sensed signals (input/output); the results are correlated with the ones specified in the program at different inputs and outputs. The engineer in this area has to design all the test setup (Hardware & software).
